title: Warm Spicy Turkish Guanciale Kebabs
description: A spicy and cozy Turkish dish featuring guanciale and ferment-jang, served in a bento-box, perfect for a low-fat friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the guanciale, onion, bell pepper, and tomato onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together the ferment-jang, turkish red pepper, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread pieces in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers and pita bread from the oven and brush the pita bread with olive oil.
Assemble the kebabs by placing a few pieces of the toasted pita bread into the bottom of a bento-box, followed by a skewer and a dollop of the ferment-jang mixture.
Serve the kebabs warm and enjoy.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining ingredients.
